sources.title: arcange9/Munyarwanda-AI-Dataset · Datasets at Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a starter seed, not a production-scale Kinyarwanda corpus. It includes curated examples and synthetic paraphrases. For serious model training, add properly licensed real Kinyarwanda text, human-reviewed instruction data, deduplication, PII filtering, quality checks, and benchmark evaluation. Hugging Face Upload these files to: arcange9/Munyarwanda-AI-Dataset
